components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: Condensed caption over a Graduate headline numeral; tiles butted on steel-soft gaps.

narrative.overview:
The league hangs the way the program hangs its banners in the State Farm Center: every fantasy team is a banner of navy felt, and the standings are the row of banners overhead. The ground is the arena ceiling at night, one navy with a single soft wash of light behind the masthead. Panels are Illini Blue felt hung on it. Steel is the line of the rafters: rules, borders, wires. White ink is the lettering. Orange is the light that tells you which banner is yours.

It is a working stat sheet, not a broadcast. Density is high and even: tables keep one reading size and rank by weight and case, lists keep one row shape, and state is carried by form before colour. The thing you came for is lit and lifted; everything else steps back a shade until you point at it. There is one theme, navy, and no light mode.

The system refuses the category's dark scoreboard dashboard: no big VS split, no neon accent, no grid of identical cards.
keyCharacteristics: Navy ground, Illini Blue felt panels, steel rules, banner-white ink; one navy theme only.
Illinois Orange spent on exactly three things: your team, scores, and the primary action.
Stitching is state: solid for actual, dashed for projected, doubled for final.
A varsity block (Graduate) for banner monograms and headline numerals only; Barlow for everything else.
Lengths and positions are exact quantities, never decoration.

rules.name: The Three Spends Rule
rules.body: Orange goes to your team, scores, and the primary action, and nowhere else. Free-agent chips, chrome, and neutral state are steel. If a new use of orange cannot be named as one of the three, it is steel.

rules.name: The Live Is Not Yours Rule
rules.body: Live mint and orange never substitute for each other; a row can be both yours and live, and must read as both.

rules.name: The Varsity Block Rule
rules.body: Graduate is for banner monograms and headline numerals only: stat-tile values, matchup scores, and scores at the large step and up. Never for body, labels, names, or a clock that ticks every second; a ticking clock is tabular Barlow so its digits keep their width.

rules.name: The One Reading Size Rule
rules.body: Every table and list reads at one size (0.875rem). Rank comes from weight (700 for the name that matters, 400 for the uncounted) and case (condensed caps for heads), never from a second size.

rules.name: The Caps Are Labels Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is only the condensed label voice, attached to a value, a column, or a state. It is not a kicker above a heading.

rules.name: The Exact Length Rule
rules.body: A length or a position on screen is a quantity: a banner's drop is its points-for against the league's most (148px plus up to 96px), a range strip's tick is the projection. Nothing grows or sweeps in to look lively, and a bar whose scale changes with the page is removed rather than kept as decoration.

rules.name: The Focus Lifts Rule
rules.body: In a list of peers, yours is raised felt with the lift shadow and an orange border; the others sit at 78% opacity and come back to full on hover or focus.

rules.name: The Stitching Rule
rules.body: The border a number wears says what kind of number it is: solid 2px for actual, dashed 2px for projected, 4px double for final. Dashes are reserved for projections and pre-season banners (and the waiting draft clock); empty states, dividers, and decoration never dash.

rules.name: The No Side-Stripe Rule
rules.body: No coloured stripe down a row's or card's edge. School colour rides on the avatar's outer ring. The rafters' full-width 4px steel rule is a deliberate exception: it is the beam the banners hang from, spans the whole width, and is not a side tab.

dos: **Do** spend orange only on your team, scores, and the primary action; make everything else steel.
**Do** stitch numbers by kind: solid for actual, dashed for projected, 4px double for final.
**Do** set banner monograms and headline numerals in Graduate, and everything else in Barlow or Barlow Condensed.
**Do** keep tables and lists at one 0.875rem reading size, ranking by weight and case.
**Do** make lengths exact: a banner's drop is points-for, a tick is the projection.
**Do** lift the reader's own item (raised felt, lift shadow, orange border) and dim its peers to 78%.
**Do** put school colour on the avatar's outer ring.
**Do** use the drawn Arrow glyph wherever an arrow acts as an icon.
**Do** pair live mint with a word or a breathing dot.
donts: **Don't** use orange for free-agent chips, chrome, or neutral state.
**Don't** set a ticking clock, a name, or a label in Graduate.
**Don't** use a dashed border for anything that is not a projection or a pre-season banner, including empty states.
**Don't** put an icon tile in an empty state.
**Don't** add coloured side-stripes to rows or cards.
**Don't** introduce a second reading size in a table.
**Don't** build a VS split, a neon accent, or a grid of identical stat cards.
**Don't** type an arrow character as an icon.
